title: Kinetica-2 Y2 / Qianfan polar group (Jiuquan LA-140)

azimuth_deg.note: mean great-circle bearing from pad to centroids of NOTAM ZLHW A5561/26 danger area (32.625N 99.042E, 186.93 deg, 917 km) and ZPKM A5562/26 (30.367N 98.904E, 186.24 deg, 1168 km), both valid 2026-11-03 ~00:05-00:46Z; implies i ~95.0 deg (retrograde near-polar)

payload_kg.note: FITTED to reach the assumed orbit at the published typical S2 first cutoff; 18 Qianfan sats now confirmed by Chinese state/commercial media after launch (e.g. https://x.com/DailyBeijing/status/2117514278206898575); mass unpublished, fitted value is NOT an estimate

insertion_alt_km.assumption: insertion orbit unpublished (LL2: polar); 500 km circular ASSUMED = CAS Space's published SSO capability reference orbit (8 t to 500 km SSO, https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/力箭二号)

header_notes: FLOWN: liftoff 2026-11-03T00:15Z (Mon 2 Nov 4:15 pm PST) per LL2 (status Launch Successful, update 2026-11-03T00:55Z citing https://m.weibo.cn/detail/5361090570488447); Chinese media (e.g. Ke Chuang Ban Daily via X https://x.com/najoygo/status/2117424232691056846) give 08:15:25 BJT = 00:15:25Z, 25 s after LL2's minute-precision time (not adopted). Payload: 18 SpaceSail/Qianfan polar 'group 21' satellites sent to the preset orbit (Beijing Daily https://x.com/DailyBeijing/status/2117514278206898575; LL2 calls it 'Polar Group #17' - group-number conflict). Retimed 2026-11-03 from pre-flight NET 2026-11-03T00:10:00Z. Geometry remains the pre-flight ILLUSTRATIVE build (orbit still unpublished).
Event times = CAS Space TYPICAL Kinetica-2 sequence (Y1 documentary via huijiwiki), not this flight's; S1 burn/sep ASSUMED. UNTUNED: no altitude/range knots exist to tune against.

t_s.src: https://sat.huijiwiki.com/wiki/力箭二号 typical sequence '星箭分离 514.710 s' (CAS Space Y1 documentary)

deploy.src: CAS Space typical sequence via huijiwiki: payload separation T+514.710 s (TYPICAL, not Y2-specific)
deploy.label: Payload separation (typical sequence)

drag.basis: ASSUMPTION: free-molecular Cd 2.2, frontal area of 3.35 m-diameter stage 2

notes: S2 second burn (restart 806.71 s, cutoff 811.71 s in the typical sequence) is after payload separation (disposal-class) and is not modelled.

fitted.method: scipy least_squares (TRF, bounded) vs published knots + target orbit

payload_kg.basis: upper bound LEO capability 12 t (huijiwiki/W); 18 Qianfan sats (unofficial count) mass not published
